title: Rig Plot fixture library
description: Canonical fixture data shared by Distro, Patch, Truss and Pull Plot. Every measured attribute carries its own provenance — the label the source used is part of the record, because mislabelled figures are this project's known failure mode.

id.description: Stable slug. Never renamed once a tool references it.

power.description: Nominal max draw in VA. NOT LED engine wattage and NOT lamp wattage — those two substitutions are the project's known failure mode, which is why sourceLabel is required.

connection.description: Default connection mode. An L-L load loads both its legs at full line current.

dmx.description: Channel counts per personality; default is the mode the tools assume.

family.description: Case family, e.g. Standard, Tall Standard, 4-way top-loader.

note.description: One rental house's convention. Meant to be edited.

sourceLabel.description: Verbatim, what the source calls this number: 'Max power consumption', 'LED engine wattage', 'Lamp wattage'. The label is the finding.

conflicting.description: When status is conflicting: every competing value with its own source. Unresolved on purpose.
